testrail._comment: Credentials (username, api_key) are read from the secrets file at BC_SECRETS_FILE (default ~/.buddy-council-secrets.json), NOT from here. Put only the non-secret base URL in env. Setting an env var here still takes precedence if you prefer the legacy inline style.

github._comment: OPTIONAL: only needed if you chose the 'mcp' GitHub enrichment strategy in /bc:setup. Otherwise delete this entry. Requires `github-mcp-server` installed externally — see https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server. Unlike the testrail/jira servers, this external server reads GITHUB_TOKEN from its env and cannot read the secrets file, so the token must live here. If you chose the 'cli' strategy, gh CLI handles auth via its own keychain and this entry is not used.
